bibliographic.title: Karen's Secret
bibliographic.author: goddamusername
bibliographic.description:
You take the role of a man in his late twenties/early thirties, who is head-over-heels in love with Karen. After a blissful eight months together, you are ready to propose to her. One day, however, you stumble upon a secret she had kept hidden from you. Your choices will determine how the secret affects you, your perception of Karen and the state of your relationship from now on.

This is a CYOA style game with seven endings. The focus is more on the story and the relationship between you and Karen - so there is no "win" condition, the choices merely decide the evolution of the relationship.
